name: SysAid
summary: SysAid ITSM Professional costs $59 per agent a month on annual billing, and the page's example prices 70 agents at $49,560 a year. Enterprise starts at 20 agents and is priced by quote. A free trial is offered with no stated length for ITSM. The help desk covers incident, problem, change, request and SLA management, and the self-service page mentions a catalog.

facts.text: The ITSM Professional plan lists request, incident, change and problem management, asset management and SLA management.
SysAid also sells an AI product called Dex at $89 or $189 per technician a month, priced separately from ITSM.
The product page lists PinkVERIFY certification and PeopleCert accreditation as an ITIL 4 tool vendor, and does not mention SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

plans.name: ITSM Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing starting at 20 agents. Adds a sandbox and advanced BI

hiddenCosts: Dex, the AI add-on product, is priced separately from ITSM.
